828: 			var totalPageFaults uint32
829: 			var processCount int
830: 			for _, s := range stats {
831: 				totalContextSwitches += s.ContextSwitches
832: 				totalPageFaults += s.PageFaults

924: 	dm.mu.Lock()
925: 	defer dm.mu.Unlock()

931: 	}

938: 		node.Status = status
939: 		// When bringing a node back online, refresh its heartbeat so the
940: 		// health-check goroutine (checkNodeHealth, 2-min stale threshold)
941: 		// doesn't immediately revert it back to "offline".
942: 		if status == "online" {
943: 			node.LastHeartbeat = time.Now()
944: 		}
945: 	}
946: 	if location, ok := updates["location"].(string); ok {
947: 		node.Location = location
948: 	}
949: 	if ipAddress, ok := updates["ip_address"].(string); ok {
950: 		node.IPAddress = ipAddress
951: 	}
952: 	if stakeAmount, ok := updates["stake_amount"].(float64); ok {
953: 		node.StakeAmount = int64(stakeAmount)
954: 	}
955: 	if capabilities, ok := updates["capabilities"].([]interface{}); ok {
956: 		node.Capabilities = make([]string, len(capabilities))

958: 			if capStr, ok := cap.(string); ok {

960: 			}
961: 		}
962: 	}

964: 	node.UpdatedAt = time.Now()
965:

967: 	if err := dm.storeNode(node); err != nil {
968: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to update node: %w", err)
969: 	}
970: 
971: 	// Update in tracker
972: 	dm.nodeTracker.UpdateNode(node)

976: }
